claims: The 130th Boston Marathon will take place on Monday, April 20, 2026.
The 130th Boston Marathon will take place on Patriots' Day.
Over 34,000 participants from around the world are expected to compete in the 130th Boston Marathon.
The 130th Boston Marathon follows the traditional 26.2-mile course from Hopkinton to Boston's Boylston Street.
The qualifying window for the 130th Boston Marathon closed on September 12, 2025.
The cutoff time for the 130th Boston Marathon qualifying window was 4:34.
Approximately 34,000 runners are expected to participate in the 130th Boston Marathon.
Over 4,600 runners from Massachusetts are expected to participate in the 130th Boston Marathon.
The Men's Wheelchair division of the 130th Boston Marathon starts at 9:02 a.m. ET.
The Women's Wheelchair division of the 130th Boston Marathon starts at 9:05 a.m. ET.
The Professional Men division of the 130th Boston Marathon starts at 9:37 a.m. ET.
The Professional Women division of the 130th Boston Marathon starts at 9:45 a.m. ET.
The Rolling Start (Waves) of the 130th Boston Marathon starts at 10:00 a.m. ET.
The 130th Boston Marathon will be broadcast live on ESPN2.
The 130th Boston Marathon will be broadcast live locally on WCVB Channel 5.
The 2026 Boston Marathon marks the 50th anniversary of the 1976 "Run for the Hoses" marathon.
The 1976 "Run for the Hoses" marathon was infamous for high heat.
24,362 runners were accepted as qualifiers for the 130th Boston Marathon.
33,249 applications were received for the 130th Boston Marathon.
